verdict.rationale: Gmail exposes a public API, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair capability to ask about. The evidence pack documents no sandbox, test mailbox, or isolated environment. Adjacent features do not count as sandbox isolation from production data: draft creation, Undo Send, and read-only OAuth scopes all still act on the real mailbox.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
